svg.title: Thermal Brown Stochastic LLG Dynamics and Boltzmann Equilibrium Validation
svg.desc: Two-panel scientific figure showing (a) numerical Stratonovich Heun stochastic LLG trajectories and ensemble mean versus deterministic relaxation, fluctuation-dissipation amplitude with bare gamma_mu0, and rejected-step raw-draw reuse, and (b) exact Boltzmann equilibrium density P_eq(theta) against ensemble 95% confidence intervals.

svg.text: σin = √[ 2αi kB T / (γμ0 μ0 Ms,i Vi Δtn) ]
Bare γμ0 in denominator: 1/(1+α2) applied once by LLG
Rejected adaptive retry: reuse ξin, rescale σ ∝ Δt−1/2

text.tspan: Peq(θ) = [ξ/(2 sinh ξ)] sin θ exp(ξ cos θ), ξ = 2.0

svg.text: Statistical qualification: verify variance scaling ∝ Tα/(VΔt) and Peq(θ) CIs
across CPU/GPU RNG streams (not bitwise trajectory identity).
FDM: fixed-step Heun · FEM CPU: adaptive retry reuse · FEM GPU: gated
